mobbin:58c88fe6-2777-4b0f-8011-c816bff6d.summary: An admin picks Group from Create, configures a multi-invitee event type (duration, location, availability, invitee limit) in a side panel, and creates it.
steps: Create menu: pick Group event type
New Meeting panel: Group, limit 2
Name webinar; invitee limit expanded
Invitee limit shown as Group of 2
Duration set to 1 hr
Location options: Zoom, Phone, In-person
Full location list including Meet, Teams
Location set to Google Meet; Create ready
Availability: 60 days, 4h notice, hours
Custom weekly hours Mon to Fri
Weekly Unavailable and date-specific hours
Availability finished; Create
steal: The Create menu states how many hosts and invitees up front (One-on-one, Group, Round robin, Collective) (screen 1).
An invitee limit on Group sets capacity per generated slot ('Group event with 2 invitees') (screens 2 to 4).
A quick-create side panel keeps the list visible and offers 'More options' when needed (screens 2 to 8).
Availability covers a rolling horizon, minimum notice and date-specific overrides (screens 9 to 12).
avoid: A long multi-screen create with near-duplicate panels for duration, location and limit costs too many clicks for a simple capacity event.
mobbin:58c88fe6-2777-4b0f-8011-c816bff6d.fit: Scheduling: maps to flexi capacity per slot and simple event types (scenario plus seats). Extends LearningSpace filtering with a group max-attendees, not Excel import.

mobbin:5c1d65f9-65f5-48a9-b250-d04ba6f1a.summary: An admin creates a Round Robin event type, builds a rotating host pool, sets per-host locations and host-specific availability, then previews and saves.
steps: Create menu: pick Round robin
Round Robin: add co-host or host pool
Named Round Robin; rotating host pool
Reschedule: reassign or keep same hosts
Pool of 3 hosts; reschedule keeps hosts
Per-host location list; Set location for all
Select location list per host
Alex on Google Meet; others still empty
Mix of Meet and Phone with number
Remaining hosts get Meet or phone
Availability by host and timezone
Booking preview calendar; Save changes
steal: A Round Robin Pool card says 'Rotating through N hosts' (screens 2 to 5).
Rescheduling asks whether to reassign through the pool or keep the original hosts (screen 4).
Per-host location plus 'Set location for all' covers cases where location varies by host (screens 6 to 10).
Availability 'Set by host' lists each host's hours by timezone (screen 11).
avoid: Making per-host location mandatory before Create when the pool has more than one host blocks save until every faculty member has a room or link.
mobbin:5c1d65f9-65f5-48a9-b250-d04ba6f1a.fit: Scheduling: direct pattern for faculty rotation across identical scenario sessions. Keep collective and round-robin from the baseline; map hosts to faculty and location to room.

mobbin:f9b02a84-c8b6-4997-aa01-1f7d9de77.summary: The user opens Calendar sync, chooses Google, Outlook, Exchange or iCloud to connect, then configures which calendars are checked for conflicts versus where new events are written.
steps: Calendar sync: conflicts vs Add to calendar
Select providers; iCloud help video
Connect list: Google, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud
Duplicate-connect error; sync config after
steal: 'Check for conflicts' (read many) is split from 'Add to calendar' (write one) (screens 1 and 4).
The provider list includes Outlook and Exchange Server explicitly (screens 2 to 3).
An account cap (1/6) sits next to Add Calendar Account (screen 1).
An on-screen error appears when a calendar is already connected (screen 4).
mobbin:f9b02a84-c8b6-4997-aa01-1f7d9de77.fit: Scheduling: core Outlook sync pattern for Essentials. Which calendars block room or faculty time versus where session invites are written; cheap to adopt on top of existing sync.
